scripts.package:chrome: vite build && node -e "import{readFileSync as r,writeFileSync as w}from'node:fs';const f='dist/manifest.json',m=JSON.parse(r(f,'utf8'));delete m.browser_specific_settings;w(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2)+'\n')" && rm -f nostr-wot-chrome.zip && cd dist && zip -rX ../nostr-wot-chrome.zip . -x '.vite/*'
scripts.package:firefox: vite build && node -e "import{readFileSync as r,writeFileSync as w}from'node:fs';const f='dist/manifest.json',m=JSON.parse(r(f,'utf8'));m.background.scripts=[m.background.service_worker];delete m.background.service_worker;w(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2)+'\n')" && rm -f nostr-wot-firefox.zip && cd dist && zip -rX ../nostr-wot-firefox.zip . -x '.vite/*' && cd .. && vite build
scripts.sync:safari: rsync -a --delete dist/ "safari-xcode/Nostr WoT/Nostr WoT Extension/Resources/" && node -e "import{readFileSync as r,writeFileSync as w}from'node:fs';const f='safari-xcode/Nostr WoT/Nostr WoT Extension/Resources/manifest.json',m=JSON.parse(r(f,'utf8'));if(m.background&&m.background.service_worker){m.background={scripts:[m.background.service_worker],persistent:true};}w(f,JSON.stringify(m,null,2)+'\n')"
scripts.test:payments: node --import tsx --import ./tests/helpers/register-mocks.ts --test tests/wallet/payment-integration.test.ts tests/wallet/payment-intents.test.ts tests/wallet/lnbits.test.ts tests/wallet/lnurl.test.ts tests/wallet/approval.test.ts tests/wallet/permissions.test.ts
